test_cases.description: getRouteManifest returns an array with exactly 13 entries
Every RouteEntry has path (string), label (string), and componentKey (PageComponentKey)
assertions: every entry has a string path
every entry has a string label
every entry has a string componentKey

test_cases.description: The set of paths matches the exact canonical set of 13 paths
assertions: path set equals canonical set exactly

test_cases.description: Every PageComponentKey variant appears exactly once across all entries
assertions: componentKey set equals full PageComponentKey enum set

test_cases.description: All path values are unique — no duplicates
All label values are non-empty strings
Every path starts with / and contains only lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens
Array order is Home first, then steps 0 through 7 in ascending order
assertions: paths appear in canonical navigation order

test_cases.description: buildPageComponentMap returns a map with exactly 13 entries
Every PageComponentKey variant is a key in the returned map
Every value in the map is a valid React.ComponentType (function)
Map keys correspond 1:1 with ROUTE_MANIFEST componentKey values
assertions: set of map keys equals set of manifest componentKeys

test_cases.description: App renders without throwing when wrapped in MemoryRouter at /
Navigating to each of the 13 manifest paths renders the correct page component
assertions: each route path renders its associated component content

test_cases.description: Navigating to a path not in ROUTE_MANIFEST renders nothing or a fallback (no crash)
assertions: no known page component text is rendered

test_cases.description: renderEntryPoint creates a React root on #root and renders App inside StrictMode
test_cases.setup_description: Create a div#root in document.body before calling
assertions: #root element has rendered content after call

test_cases.description: renderEntryPoint throws or errors when document has no #root element
assertions: function throws or returns error when #root is absent
